name: GooeyNav-TS-TW
title: GooeyNav
description: A short row of links keeps one item wrapped in a white pill. Clicking another link launches a cluster of soft white blobs that merge into a new pill around the chosen label.
use: A short site menu should make switching sections feel playful and obvious.
avoid: It is a minimal link row rather than a full header, and the particles add noise for frequent use.
a11y: Links fire on Enter and Space, but outline-none removes the focus ring and the particles ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four short white labels sit in a row on a near-black stage, spaced widely apart. The current item is wrapped in a white rounded pill with black text, and stray white dots can hover around it.
behaves: Clicking a link throws a spray of soft white particles across the row, which blob together into a white pill under that label while its text turns black.
customise: Items with a label and href, plus animation time, particle count, distances, radius, time variance, colour indexes and start index are props.
weight: light: A few links and about fifteen short-lived particle spans per click; idle otherwise.
